lines.opening: Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant calling, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?
lines.third_party_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.third_party_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name} directly.
lines.callback_window: I can only arrange a call today or on the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00. Is there a time in that window that works?
lines.callback_done: Thank you. We will call back on {when}.
lines.deceased: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before I continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_fail: I'm sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.id_retry: That does not match our records. Could you tell me {label} again?
lines.id_swapped: Could you say the month as a word, please?
lines.id_unreadable: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you tell me {label} again?
lines.id_more: Could you give me the rest of {label}, please?
lines.verified: Thank you, your identity is verified.
lines.disclosure_intro: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.disclosure_item: Your {product} has {past_due} past due, {days_late} days late.
lines.first_ask_single: Can you make this payment today?
lines.first_ask_multi: Can you pay all of them today?
lines.floor_offer: I can record a payment of {amount} instead.
lines.ask_exact_day: Which exact day would that be?
lines.next_business_day_offer: {asked} is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work?
lines.deadline_offer: The latest date I can record is {date}. Can you pay by then?
lines.past_date: That date has already passed. Which day from today on would work?
lines.date_conflict: Just to be sure, did you mean {date}?
lines.readback_clamped: {amount} for your {product} on {date}, the latest date I can record for it
lines.recorded: Your promise of {amount} for your {product} on {date} is recorded.
lines.after_promise: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record an amount below {floor}.
lines.paid_reply: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.scam_reply: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.robot_reply: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.change_in_app: A recorded promise can't be changed in this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record the promise for your {product} because of a technical problem.
lines.help_first: Before I transfer you, is there anything I can help you with myself?
lines.sympathy: I'm very sorry to hear that.
lines.support_offer: Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.dispute_reply: I understand, thank you for letting me know.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.tech_problem: I'm sorry, we are having a technical problem, so I can't continue this call right now.

questions.label: your date of birth
questions.ask: What is your date of birth?

questions.label: the last four digits of the phone number on file
questions.ask: What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

interrupts.hardship: the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss
interrupts.dispute: the customer says the debt is not theirs, they never had this product, or the product was closed or paid off in the past
interrupts.already_paid: the customer says they already paid this past-due amount
interrupts.restructuring: the customer asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments
interrupts.human: the customer asks to speak to a human or a person
